assessment_objectives.objective: the Control Validation Testing (CVT) activities that are applicable for automation through Control Assurance Automation (CAA) are identified and documented, including the controls and Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) in scope.
Control Assurance Automation (CAA) engineering practices, pipelines and tooling are used to execute machine-executable tests that validate the implementation and operation of in-scope controls.

Control Assurance Automation (CAA) pipelines and tooling automatically collect evidence from in-scope Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) and evaluate it against defined control expectations.

evidence and test results produced by Control Assurance Automation (CAA) are timestamped, attributable to the source Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) and protected from unauthorized modification.
machine-executable tests are version controlled and are reviewed and updated when the controls, Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) or evaluation criteria they test change.
failed or inconclusive Control Assurance Automation (CAA) test results are reviewed by assigned personnel and tracked to resolution.
